title: Tambe Ganpati (Shrimant Tambe Mandal)
text:
Tambe Ganpati (Shrimant Tambe Mandal) (ताम्बे गणपती (श्रीमंत ताम्बे मंडळ)) — Iconic Sarvajanik Mandal, located in Sadashiv Peth, Pune, established Early 20th century.

History: Shrimant Tambe Mandal is a well-known traditional mandal of Sadashiv Peth, historically associated with Brahmin scholars, classical arts and Pune's intellectual life. For decades it has emphasised classical music, religious recitations and culturally rooted programs over spectacular decoration, popular with those who prefer an authentic, refined festival experience.

Idol/Deity: Traditional Ganesh idol emphasising religious and cultural authenticity over visual grandeur.
